title: "Download"
subtitle: "Where to get DeskPets"
---

::: {.callout-note}
## No installer yet
A one-click installer for Windows is planned and **has not been released**. There is no download to offer yet, and I'd rather say so than link to something that doesn't exist.
:::

## Run it today

For now you run DeskPets from source with [pixi](https://pixi.sh), which sets up the right Python and libraries. It takes four lines, and [Getting started](/guide/getting-started.qmd) walks through it.

The plan is on the [Roadmap](roadmap.qmd).

## Requirements

- **Windows.** macOS and Linux aren't supported.
- **An NVIDIA GPU is optional.** Without one, DeskPets still runs, but the GPU rows and the GPU-temperature trigger for the grumpy animation aren't available. See [Known limitations](/guide/known-limitations.qmd).

## Follow along

Progress is tracked on [GitHub](https://github.com/Suyash-Naik/DeskPets/issues). Watching the repository there is the quickest way to hear when a release appears.
